holdings.name: code_github_clean
holdings.provenance: GitHub public repositories (permissive licenses), deduped + cleaned

A.name: Mathematical Foundations
A.evidence: No dedicated math sources (open-web-math, proof-pile-2, OpenStax math, SE math). FineWeb-edu contains incidental web math but insufficient for domain bar.

B.name: Statistics / Measurement / Inference
B.evidence: No statistics sources (Cross Validated, OpenStax stats, NIST handbooks, arXiv stat.*). General web (fineweb) has incidental statistics content only.

C.name: Physics / Dynamical Systems / Resource Reality
C.evidence: No physics sources (OpenStax physics, arXiv physics.*, DOE/EIA reports). Current corpus has no dedicated physics content.

D.name: Computer Science / Algorithms / Systems
D.evidence: code_github_clean provides strong CS code. Wikipedia-en has CS content. Missing: IETF RFC, arXiv cs.*, SE dumps (algorithms/systems tags). Networking underrepresented.

E.name: ML / AI / Model Science
E.evidence: No arXiv cs.LG / cs.CL / cs.CV papers, no NeurIPS/ICML, no Distill.pub. No research literature. General web insufficient for floor.

F.name: Training Infrastructure / CUDA / Kernels / Hardware
F.evidence: code_github_clean may contain PyTorch/CUDA codebases but lacks CUDA docs, CUTLASS, Triton, consumer-GPU guides. No pinned OSS hardware tooling.

G.name: Formal Logic / Verification / Proof
G.evidence: No Lean mathlib, Metamath, Isabelle AFP, Coq stdlib, or formal-proof corpora. Current sources have no formal-logic content.

H.name: Software Engineering / Debugging / Testing
H.evidence: code_github_clean includes test suites + issue/PR discussion. Wikipedia-en has engineering content. Missing: SO debugging/testing tags, postmortems, engineering handbooks, arXiv cs.SE.

I.name: Data / Corpus / Evaluation / Decontamination
I.evidence: No dataset reports (FineWeb docs, Dolma, Pile paper), no contamination papers, no Croissant docs, no HF dataset cards. Charter floor absent.

J.name: Scientific Method / Lab Operation / Receipts
J.evidence: No Turing Way, PLOS papers, protocols.io, OSF guides, or negative-results literature. No reproducibility epistemics in corpus.

K.name: Application Worlds
K.evidence: code_github_clean has general application code. Lacks CAD/BIM (ABC dataset, IFC specs), robotics (ROS, X-Embodiment), building-data integration. Diversity thin.

census_method: one-pass inventory classification of v0-pretrain corpus holdings against 11-domain charter floor (issues #649-#659); token counts from token-shards-v0-20260611T170047Z.json
floor_attestation: current corpus falls 7 domains short of charter floor (A, B, C, E, G, I, J completely absent; F, K thin). no single source covers diversity bar for any domain except narrow D/code slice. 13GB total corpus with 6.974B tokens; acquisition pipeline must prioritize P0 domains (A, D, E, I) immediately.
